about_zh: 从模型到智能体，本仓库里最密集的一块。

repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是面向 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，集成 Hopper、Ghidra 等引擎，支持无源码剖析原生二进制、Electron 应用及 .NET 运行时行为，实现底层逻辑的自动化分析与复刻。
repos.summary_en: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an AI-agent-centric reverse engineering platform designed to bridge AI agents with powerful analysis tools like Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It enables automated, deep inspection of native binaries, Electron applications, .NET assemblies, and web technologies entirely without source code access. By running locally and generating evidence-backed reports, it helps developers understand complex runtime behaviors and binary logic, facilitating the rapid replication of advanced application features in their own development projects.

repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
repos.summary_zh: OmniRoute是一个免费MIT许可的AI网关，通过统一端点聚合359个提供商、1200+模型，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流编码工具。其智能配额感知自动回退与RTK+Caveman压缩技术可节省高达95%的令牌成本，适用于需要低成本、多模型访问的开发者与团队。
repos.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free MIT-licensed AI gateway that aggregates 359 providers and over 1,200 models behind a unified endpoint, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding tools. It features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression to save up to 95% tokens, making it ideal for developers and teams seeking low-cost, multi-model AI access.

repos.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.
repos.summary_zh: 1Panel是一款现代化开源Linux服务器面板及轻量级AI管理平台。通过直观Web界面提供一站式运维，深度融合AI网关与智能体管理，简化主机与容器管理，助力网站和AI应用快速部署，显著降低运维门槛。
repos.summary_en: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform loved by a global community of over 2.5 million users. Through an intuitive web interface, it provides comprehensive, one-stop server operations, seamlessly integrating AI gateway, agent, and model management. It streamlines host monitoring, container orchestration, database management, curated app store deployments, and rapid website setup, significantly lowering the technical barrier for efficient server and AI application administration.

repos.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。
repos.summary_zh: 张雪峰认知操作系统，整合5本著作与30+语录，提供高考志愿、考研及职业规划的实战思维框架，包含5个心智模型与8条决策启发式，助力用户做出理性选择。基于深度调研，模拟真实决策场景，提升规划效率。
repos.summary_en: Zhang Xuefeng's cognitive operating system distills five core mental models and eight decision heuristics from extensive research, offering a practical framework for gaokao, graduate school, and career planning. By simulating real-world scenarios, it helps users make rational, data-driven choices. The system integrates insights from five books, fifteen in-depth interviews, and over thirty firsthand quotes, providing a comprehensive knowledge base. It applies employment-driven reasoning, family background stratification, and the 'sieve of society' concept to guide students and parents through complex educational decisions, ensuring strategic advantage in a competitive landscape.

repos.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多个 AI 编码中转站与公益站，提供免费额度与一键配置脚本，助力开发者零成本体验 Claude Code、Codex 等顶级模型。实时监控站点可用性，自动更新额度与价格，支持多种协议，是 AI 编码探索的高效入口。
repos.summary_en: Aggregate multiple AI coding relay and charity stations, offering free credits and one-click setup scripts, enabling developers to access top models like Claude Code and Codex at zero cost. With real-time availability monitoring and auto-updating data, it supports multiple protocols, serving as an efficient entry point for AI coding exploration.
